profile.headline: Consultant/Software Developer  at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: Full-stack web developer with strong leadership and interpersonal skills who possesses a sincere passion for programming. Ability to complete projects from database to front-end design with Python, Ruby, and JS MEAN Stack (MongoDB, Express, Angular2, Node.js). Active TS/SCI

positions.title: Consultant/ Software Developer
positions.description: Consultant/ Junior Software Developer in support of the Defense and Intelligence Group.

positions.title: Coding Resident
positions.description:
An immersive full stack development program. Graduated with a Black Belt (highest earning of achievement) in the Python, Ruby on Rails, and MEAN Stack, with over 1000 hours of coding experience, and a working proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS as well as a wide range of other frameworks and libraries.

- Ability to develop a web app from scratch, back-end to the front-end and finally to deployment
- Expertise in RESTful routes, CRUD operations, and API integration
- Knowledgeable in SQL and NoSQL ERD diagrams to establish connection between multiple datasets

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: - Counter Surveillance consulting and practical exercise facilitator. Operations support specialist.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
- Collaborated with developers and engineers to create and deploy technical solutions to facilitate intelligence collection; intelligence gathered was critical to support military operations and government decision-making. 
- Facilitated field operations, trained local assets, and implemented collection systems at foreign collection sites.
- Deployed to various countries to facilitate logistics, coordinate with local partners, and implement systems abroad.
- Determine vendors, procure and test equipment for technical solutions in the field.

positions.title: Security Analyst
positions.description:
Aided in the implementation and oversight of security mechanisms for the organization locations in over 30 countries. Analyzed security information, identified  trends of threats and security incidents affecting Counterpart system personnel, assets and operations in specific countries
Conduct security briefing and memorandums for Counterpart staff deploying abroad. Provided support to Counterpart's Director of Global safety and security. Created maps of site locations, critical infrastructure, and security incidents.

positions.title: All-Source Intelligence Chief/ Analyst
positions.description: Highly motivated USMC trained intelligence analyst with five years of experience and expertise in conducting all-source intelligence analysis to directly support two combat operations against a rapidly shifting enemy in a high operational environment. Proven record of applying advanced intelligence analytic skills to identify, assess, interpret, and report potential threats. Experience working with adjacent units and inter-agency partners to coordinate intelligence and procure support. Worked under tight deadlines in high-pressure situations to support commanders and troops with critical intelligence products.
